moments.title: Premier League is BACK!
moments.blurb: The 2026/27 Premier League season kicks off today, Friday, August 21st, with Arsenal hosting newly-promoted Coventry City.

source.l: Premier League Official Site / The Guardian

angles.name: Opening Day Excitement
angles.copy: It's here! The Premier League is back with a bang today as Arsenal take on Coventry City. Who are you backing for the opening weekend?

angles.name: Weekend Fixtures Buzz
angles.copy: Premier League weekend incoming! Hull City face Man Utd tomorrow, while Sunday sees Brighton vs Aston Villa, Man City vs Bournemouth, and Newcastle vs Liverpool. What a start to the season!

moments.title: August Bank Holiday approaches
moments.blurb: The Late Summer Bank Holiday for England, Wales, and Northern Ireland is on Monday, August 31st, providing a long weekend to round off the summer.

angles.name: Long Weekend Countdown
angles.copy: Counting down to that glorious extra day off! The August Bank Holiday is just over a week away. What are your plans for the long weekend?

angles.name: Summer's Last Hurrah
angles.copy: The Late Summer Bank Holiday on August 31st is the unofficial end of summer for many. Make the most of it!

moments.title: Reading & Leeds Festival 2026
moments.blurb: Reading & Leeds Festival takes place next weekend, August 27-30, with headliners including Charli XCX, Dave, Florence + The Machine, and Fontaines D.C.

angles.name: Festival Fever
angles.copy: Reading & Leeds Festival is almost here! Who are you most excited to see next weekend? So many huge names on the bill!

angles.name: Reading Rock-up
angles.copy: Fontaines D.C. and Florence + The Machine are set to smash it at Reading & Leeds next week. Get ready for some serious rock and indie vibes!

moments.title: Victorious Festival this weekend
moments.blurb: Victorious Festival brings big names to Portsmouth's Southsea Common from August 28-30, coinciding with the bank holiday weekend.

angles.name: Portsmouth Party
angles.copy: Victorious Festival is just one week away! Who's heading to Southsea Common for a bank holiday weekend of music by the sea?

moments.title: All Points East Live in London
moments.blurb: The All Points East festival runs from August 21-30 in London, featuring a diverse lineup of artists.

angles.name: East London Festivities
angles.copy: All Points East is ON! East London is buzzing with incredible music over the next week. Who are you catching at Victoria Park?

moments.title: We Out Here Festival Underway
moments.blurb: Gilles Peterson's We Out Here Festival, celebrating jazz and UK club culture, is taking place in Dorset from August 20-23.

angles.name: Dorset Dance Delights
angles.copy: We Out Here Festival is bringing the best of jazz and club culture to Dorset this weekend! Gilles Peterson knows how to throw a party!

moments.title: Green Man Festival Live in Wales
moments.blurb: Wales' largest independent music and arts festival, Green Man, is currently live in the Brecon Beacons, offering a diverse cultural experience.

angles.name: Brecon Beacons Beats
angles.copy: Green Man Festival is in full swing in the beautiful Brecon Beacons! Who's soaking up the music, arts, and incredible atmosphere this weekend?

angles.name: Welsh Festival Vibes
angles.copy: The Brecon Beacons are alive with Green Man Festival this weekend! If you're there, let us know who you're excited to see!

moments.title: Strictly Come Dancing is back next month!
moments.blurb: The 24th series of Strictly Come Dancing is set to launch on September 19th, with new hosts Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe.

angles.name: Strictly Countdown
angles.copy: Get your glitterballs ready! Strictly Come Dancing returns next month with a brand new hosting trio. Who's excited for the sequins and salsa?

angles.name: New Hosts Alert
angles.copy: Big changes for Strictly this year! Emma Willis, Josh Widdicombe, and Johannes Radebe are taking the reins. What do you think of the new line-up?

moments.title: Great British Bake Off returns in September
moments.blurb: The Great British Bake Off will return to Channel 4 in September, with Nigella Lawson joining as a new judge.

angles.name: Bake Off Buzz
angles.copy: The tent is opening soon! The Great British Bake Off is back in September, and Nigella Lawson is joining the judging panel. Who's ready for some showstoppers?

angles.name: New Judge Nigella
angles.copy: Nigella Lawson in the Bake Off tent! We can't wait to see her critiques and maybe a few 'luscious' moments when the series returns next month.

moments.title: Usain Bolt turns 40
moments.blurb: Jamaican sprinting legend Usain Bolt, the fastest man alive, celebrates his 40th birthday today, August 21st.

angles.name: Birthday for the Fastest Man
angles.copy: Happy 40th birthday to the one and only Usain Bolt! The sprinting legend is celebrating today. What's your favourite Bolt moment?

moments.title: Happy Birthday Kelis!
moments.blurb: American R&B singer Kelis, known for hits like 'Milkshake' and 'Caught Out There', celebrates her 46th birthday today.

angles.name: Kelis Turns 46
angles.copy: Happy 46th Birthday to the incredible Kelis! What's your go-to track from the 'Milkshake' singer?

moments.title: Liam Howlett (The Prodigy) turns 55
moments.blurb: Liam Howlett, co-founder and mastermind of electronic music pioneers The Prodigy, celebrates his 55th birthday today.

angles.name: Prodigy Legend's Birthday
angles.copy: Sending birthday wishes to Liam Howlett of The Prodigy, who turns 55 today! What's your favourite Prodigy anthem?

moments.title: Serj Tankian (System of a Down) turns 59
moments.blurb: System of a Down frontman and distinctive vocalist Serj Tankian celebrates his 59th birthday today, August 21st.

angles.name: SOAD Singer's Day
angles.copy: Happy 59th Birthday to the iconic voice of System of a Down, Serj Tankian! What's your top SOAD track?
